title: Trace and specification defect review
objective: Review a change set and report specification, relation, state, and coverage defects.
brief: REQ-BULK-DELETE contains a new MUST statement but its test plan covers only the older single-delete statement.
TECH-BULK-API declares a strong requires relation to missing REQ-999999.
The Git base and current copies both say status approved, but the approved REQ-BULK-DELETE normative response changed.
One candidate line starts with malformed extension [risk:LEVEL=high] before ACTOR.
Report each independent defect once and identify release blockers.

baseline: Represent and review the brief as ordinary Markdown, links, and a prose test plan.
bitz: Represent and review the same brief as .spec using context and check evidence.

completionCriteria: Every critical seeded defect is reported.
Duplicate symptoms of the same cause are not double counted.
Advisory issues are separated from blockers.
